if: the supplier of taxable goods receives an amount in excess of the amount indicated in the tax invoice
that excess is up to one thousand rupees
then: the time of supply FOR THAT EXCESS AMOUNT ONLY is the date of issue of invoice in respect of the excess amount
note: At the supplier's OPTION — it is not automatic, and it applies only to the excess, not to the whole supply. One thousand rupees is the ceiling stated in the Act as updated 31-08-2021.

evidence.quote: where the supplier of taxable goods receives an amount up to                       one thousand rupees in excess of the amount indicated in the tax invoice, the time of supply to the extent of such excess amount shall, at the option of the said supplier, be the date of issue of invoice in respect of such excess amount.
